articles.title: A Robot Bird That Can Fly and Swim
articles.summary: Inspired by puffins, MIT scientists built a robot that flies through the air and swims underwater using the same flapping wings.

articles.title: One Ant Can Wake a Whole Colony
articles.summary: Acorn ant colonies rest quietly, then suddenly burst into activity. A math model shows one ant can spark the whole colony — but only when three conditions line up.

articles.title: Daffy Duck Is Back on the Big Screen
articles.summary: "Daffy Season," the first Looney Tunes short in theaters since 2012, plays before "The Cat in the Hat." It is Eric Bauza's final Looney Tunes performance.
